lead_raw_text:
The structure of NiHg₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Ni and four Hg—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Hg and Ni centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each: Hg is surrounded by 8 Hg and 4 Ni, while Ni is coordinated by 12 Hg. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Hg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Hg- and Ni-centered polyhedra.
